Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner prematurely declared the task as complete based on internal knowledge without utilizing the available capabilities (specifically WebSurfer) to verify the specific terminology requested. The user asked for the name of the "pantheon," but the Planner provided "Ogdoad (Hermopolitan pantheon)," which is a specific subgroup or cosmological group within Egyptian mythology, not the overarching pantheon (the "Ennead" of Heliopolis is the most standard answer for the main pantheon). By skipping the fact-checking step, the Planner introduced a factual inaccuracy regarding the primary classification of the gods.
